# Seven Portal example captions read whole within two lines

## Context

Completes the cross-group two-line caption fit deferred in `#21638`'s `Out of Scope` (`Country Statistics Grid`, `Sparklines`, `Mermaid Diagrams`, `Popover`) plus the three adjacent `106–141`-character captions (`File Explorer`, `OpenStreetMaps / OpenLayers`, `Tooltips`) that still overflow `.portal-example-feature`'s two-line clamp (`scrollHeight: 53 > clientHeight: 35`) across `grid-table`, `charts`, `dialogs`, and `tree` on `dev` (`6bce66de69`).

- Live latest-open + closed sweep: checked latest 20 open (50 open, orange band; folding under Epic #21358) + open and closed search (`captions two lines feature clamp`, `captions two lines`; read `#21638` and `#21584` `Out of Scope` / `Avoided Traps`) at `2026-11-23T01:49:25Z`; no open duplicate exists.
- A2A in-flight claim sweep: checked latest 30 messages across all read states (`2026-11-23T01:02Z`–`01:49Z`); `#22053` (`charts.json` / `grid-table.json` `hasLightCover`) has already merged (`6bce66de69`), and no peer claims example captions.
- MC sweep: `portal example card caption still cut after two lines Sparklines Mermaid Popover Country Statistics Grid`, 5 results, no conflicting decision.
- Own-assignment sweep: 2 open (`#22055` in Round-2 review via `#21991`, `#21847` post-cut live verification), none overlapping.
- Ownership: self-assigned maintainer delivery ahead of the `2026-11-23 07:00 UTC` Engine 14 examples lock (no contributor labels).

## The Problem

Measured in headless Chromium on `dev` (`6bce66de69`) across all 20 Portal example group routes (`#/examples/<group>`) at `1440 × 900`, `1366 × 768`, `1024 × 768`, and `641 × 800`, seven `.portal-example-feature` captions exceed two lines (`scrollHeight: 53 > clientHeight: 35`) and get cut mid-claim with an ellipsis:

| Group | Record (`id`) | Current length | Cut at two lines (`scrollHeight > clientHeight + 1`) |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `tree` | `file-explorer` | 141 chars | `1440 × 900`, `1366 × 768`, `1024 × 768`, `641 × 800` |
| `charts` | `sparklines` | 133 chars | `1440 × 900`, `1366 × 768`, `1024 × 768`, `641 × 800` |
| `charts` | `mermaid` | 121 chars | `1440 × 900`, `1366 × 768`, `1024 × 768`, `641 × 800` |
| `grid-table` | `grid-countries` | 122 chars | Compact cards at `1366 × 768`, `1024 × 768`, `641 × 800` |
| `dialogs` | `popover` | 121 chars | `1366 × 768`, `1024 × 768`, `641 × 800` |
| `dialogs` | `tooltip` | 118 chars | `641 × 800` (`301px` compact card) |
| `charts` | `open-street-maps` | 106 chars | `641 × 800` (`301px` compact card) |

## The Architectural Reality

- Design authority: `#21119` Contract Ledger (`"a proof line of more than two lines is cut with an ellipsis and stays whole in the DOM"`) paired with `#21140` / `#21638` (`"captions are cut mid-claim"` — compact card captions must read whole within two lines at desktop/tablet card widths down to `641 × 800`).
- `apps/portal/resources/data/examples/{tree,charts,grid-table,dialogs}.json` own each record's `feature` string (`#21856` per-group catalog split).
- `resources/css/src/apps/portal/examples/List.css` enforces the two-line clamp on compact cards (`#21585`).
- `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` is regenerated atomically at release-cut time by `buildScripts/release/prepare.mjs` -> `rebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.mjs`.

## The Fix

Tighten the seven `feature` strings to `80–86` characters each while preserving every proof detail:
1. `tree.json` (`file-explorer`): `"Drag files between folders, rename in place, and filter while keeping matched paths."`
2. `charts.json` (`sparklines`): `"Six metric cards draw thirty live sparklines in the canvas worker once a second."`
3. `charts.json` (`mermaid`): `"Mermaid draws flowchart, sequence, class or Gantt diagrams on each edit or theme swap."`
4. `charts.json` (`open-street-maps`): `"An OpenLayers map plots 51 earthquake records with camera, zoom and marker controls"`
5. `grid-table.json` (`grid-countries`): `"217 World Bank economies with flags, formatted figures and growth tinted by value"`
6. `dialogs.json` (`popover`): `"A popover opens beside its button on the chosen side and flips when space runs out."`
7. `dialogs.json` (`tooltip`): `"Plain hints, a rich velocity card and tunable delays work by pointer or keyboard."`

## Decision Record impact

`none` — catalog `feature` copy tightening within `#21140` / `#21638`'s two-line card contract.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] All seven updated `.portal-example-feature` captions satisfy `scrollHeight <= clientHeight + 1` at rest across `#/examples/tree`, `#/examples/charts`, `#/examples/grid-table`, and `#/examples/dialogs` at `1440 × 900`, `1366 × 768`, `1024 × 768`, and `641 × 800` in headless Chromium.
- [ ] Existing Portal catalog unit and E2E specs pass without hand-editing generated `seo.json` / `sitemap*.xml` / `llms*.txt` artifacts.
- [ ] Before (`dev`) and after (branch) full-page screenshots at `1366 × 768` (`Neo Dark`) are attached to the pull request (`rendered-surface-audit.md`).

## Out of Scope

- Phone single-line card clamping (`<= 640px`, intentional per `#21584`).
- Hand-editing `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` (regenerated by `prepare.mjs` at cut time).

## Avoided Traps

- **Rewrites between `98–106` characters:** Still clip on `301–307px` compact cards at `1366 × 768` and `641 × 800` (`#21638`). Keeping all seven between `80–86` characters clears every breakpoint cleanly.
